summary: TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. 26/26 keys attempted; 5 tier lists + Archon re-read, 0 tier moves. WCL rdps broken, 3 raw keys landed. Bloodmallet MID2 held back.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched live by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 181-328 KB. Parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = tier, tier-list-entry FIRST img alt = "Spec Class" looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split positionally): 80/80 assignments (raid 27/7/6, M+ 27/7/6), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves against stored. The M+ pages carry all seven bands (S+/S/A+/A/B+/B/C) plus one literal upstream TBD (Subtlety Rogue), stored as an explicit null and never omitted. Era read per page from title AND changelog body: five titles self-identify as 12.1 / Season 2 / Midnight, and the raid-HEALER page again keeps a "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a body whose changelog reads "13 Aug. 2026: Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch after the first few live tests" — body over title per the blue-tracker precedent, so seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and Icy Veins remains season-AHEAD (out of the live consensus in its own right, into the 12.1 forecast, its final s1 letters supplied by the frozen lane). published re-read from each page rather than carried forward: raid DPS 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-13, raid tank 2026-08-08, M+ x3 2026-08-08 — agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Snapshots already stood at 2026-08-15 from earlier runs of this same UTC day, so no date could advance; the claim rests on tonight's live re-read reproducing all 80 letters.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 188-324 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way this source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40/40 specs read (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves — no rebuild since the 2026-08-09 cut, consistent with the Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue remains the literal upstream TBD and stays an explicit null (39 rated rows against a floor of 24). published RE-READ from each page, never carried forward: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence; the in-body "Last UPDATED" line still says 08-02 and dateModified wins per refresh-tiers precedence. Snapshot already at today's date from an earlier run of this UTC day.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Non-roster alts were rejected by ROSTER MATCH and never by position — the 8 Season-2 dungeon names (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) and the Method logo. Self-dates unchanged from the previous run: raid "Last Updated 10th August 2026", M+ "Last Updated 13th August 2026"; the raid body names The Venomous Abyss three times, the M+ page lists the Season-2 dungeon set, and neither page mentions Season 1 at all. seasonVerified stays s2, so Method remains season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus in its own right, into the next-patch forecast, with its final s1 letters held in data/season-final.json keeping the consensus composition intact.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set, HTTP 200, 73-328 KB (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Parsed by unescaping \/ across the whole document FIRST and then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] — exactly one block per page, so no decoy printHtml call was in play — with tolerant whitespace inside each [tier-label] and specs resolved from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. 80 assignments (27/7/6 per bracket), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves: the two M+ DPS moves logged earlier today (Assassination Rogue B->A, Shadow Priest C->B) reproduce exactly and nothing further has changed. Self-dates re-read per page and unchanged, agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-08, raid tank 2026-08-14, M+ DPS 2026-08-15T10:38:56-05:00, M+ healer 2026-08-09, M+ tank 2026-08-11. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD, same disposition as Icy Veins and Method).

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> JSON (WebFetch markdown drops it): specTierListSection.tierLists[] read at metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping, and every entry resolved from its icon "Class-Spec" token rather than the display name (Archon writes "BeastMastery Hunter" / "Havoc DemonHunter"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Archon has NOT re-cut since the previous run of this UTC day: lastUpdated is still 2026-08-15T12:00:00Z on all six pages and the page totalParses are unchanged too (raid DPS 4277, healer 1120, tank 600), which is why the four numeric requirements below stay partial while this one does not — the letters were genuinely re-read and reproduced. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 — encounterOptions are the nine S1 bosses (Imperator ... Midnight Falls) and the M+ selector still holds the eight S1 dungeons (Algeth'ar Academy, Magisters', Maisara Caverns, Nexus-Point Xenas, Pit of Saron, Seat, Skyreach, Windrunner Spire) — so seasonVerified stays s1 and Archon remains the only source feeding the live consensus in its own right.

Full re-fetch of 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200 with __NEXT_DATA__ present, 0 unmatched icons. 618 tier rows parsed and ZERO differ from stored. The same six role cuts publish an EMPTY tier list upstream — Crown (all three roles), Chimaerus (healer, tank) and Vanguard (tank) — and three more are short (Vaelgor & Ezzorak DPS 26/27 and tank 5/6, Vanguard DPS 26/27); per the standing "empty = nothing to ingest" rule the 59 stored rows those cuts do not reproduce were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than erased. data/encounter-tiers.json is unmodified: it still holds 677 tier rows (floor 440) at Archon's own cut date 2026-08-14, never the run date, and the committed encounter `name` values were not rewritten (page.title is the generic headline, not the boss name).

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically — the third of Archon's three raid tierLists, alongside popularity and throughput): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, ZERO tiers moved. spec.survivability keeps its stored asOf 2026-08-14 because nothing moved. Standing caveat: the Season-1 raid sample behind these tiers is 4277/1120/600 parses on content that is now dead, so quiet here means frozen rather than settled.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) across the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, each with n = that spec's parse count. Every value AND every parse count is byte-identical to stored after rounding the payload floats to the stored integer precision. PARTIAL rather than success, deliberately: Archon's cut label sits at 2026-08-15T12:00:00Z while none of the numbers moved, so merging would re-date 160 unchanged values as fresh — the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf failure mode, where a label that ticks on its own can never trip a staleness gate. Nothing merged; the family's coverage date stays 2026-08-14 (1 day, threshold 5). The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection.table.data[] (hps column, n = parses): 7/7 healer specs, 0 unmatched, every value and parse count byte-identical to stored. Same disposition and same reason as archon-metrics — Archon's label is at 2026-08-15 with nothing moved, so nothing was merged and the stored date stays 2026-08-14 (1 day, threshold 5). Reported as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never hide behind the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ aggregate pages' specRankingsSection.table.data[] (score column, n = parses): 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, every value and every parse count byte-identical to stored — unchanged since the 08-10 cut. Archon's M+ numbers are genuinely frozen: Season 1 keys have been dead content since 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so the population feeding the 95th percentile has stopped growing. Nothing merged; the stored coverage date stays 2026-08-10, which is 5 days against a threshold of 5 — this row alarms on the heartbeat now, and that red is the correct signal rather than something to paper over by adopting tonight's re-stamped label.

"Popularity" re-read from specRankingsSection.table.data[] across all six aggregate pages = 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, every value byte-identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision. Shape-checked before any merge would have been considered, per the 2026-07 failure where DPS magnitudes were published under unit %: every value is a plausible percentage, each of the six (role x bracket) groups sums to ~100 and the whole set to ~600, and no row equals that spec's "95th pct DPS (Mythic)". Nothing moved, so nothing was merged and the stored coverage date stays 2026-08-10 (5 days, threshold 5 — heartbeat-visible, same frozen-Season-1 cause as archon-mplus-score).

Both JSON API calls fetched fresh with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, never the HTML page (which is a stale S3 prerender). manifest.json gives snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returns 44 blocks, of which the whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField "lowerBound" + keyRange undefined selects 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and are excluded, not merely "not dungeon"). classSpec names matched the roster 40/40 with no mapping table. The rankings file was diffed rather than trusted to its manifest — the 08-04 incident had a pinned snapshotDate over changed values — and this time both agree: Last-Modified is 11 Aug 2026 15:25 GMT and all 40 lowerBound values plus all 40 numberOfCharacters are identical to stored. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (4 days, threshold 8), never today.

This agent holds no WCL credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means; the only input is the pre-agent wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-15T21:46:08Z), whose verdict is "rdps-broken": characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error" (httpStatus 200, 0 rankings) while OAuth and GraphQL transport are both healthy (3600 points/hour, 1 spent). The evidence lands no rows for this key, so the zone-46 Mythic rDPS/HPS medians stay unchanged at 2026-08-10 (5 days, threshold 10). The HTML statistics transport that used to serve this cut is separately dead (Cloudflare human-challenge since 08-10, measured from a residential IP on 08-14), so there is no second path to try.

Same single input and same verdict as wcl-live-raid: wcl-fetch/evidence.json reports "rdps-broken" and lands no rows for this key, so the 40 stored zone-47 M+ median rows (27 rDPS + 6 tank rDPS + 7 HPS) stay unchanged at 2026-08-10. Standing distinction kept in view: "rdps-broken" is a statement about the v2 GraphQL API, not about rDPS data, and the dps-family numbers that DO return must never be substituted under an rDPS-labelled series.

Evidence verdict "rdps-broken", no rows landed for this key, so the 34 stored "12.1 PTR raid testing score (normalized)" rows stay at 2026-07-28 (18 days, threshold 40 — the temporary ceiling set 2026-08-05 for exactly this state). Two independent reasons this cut cannot come back on our side: the zone-54 cross-boss normalized 0-100 score has NO GraphQL analogue at all — only the HTML statistics table ever published it, and that transport is Cloudflare-challenged — and the PTR raid-testing window closed when 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so there is nothing upstream to refill it with either.

Evidence verdict "rdps-broken" and no rows landed for this key, so the 40 stored "Median rDPS/HPS (12.1 PTR M+ testing)" rows stay unchanged at 2026-08-10 (5 days, threshold 10). Note that the zone-56 RAW-DPS sibling (wcl-ptr-mplus-raw) DID land tonight from the same evidence file: the two series ride different recipes, and a healthy raw fetch is never evidence that the rdps family is fixed.

spec.ptrDummy stores median rDPS by fixed target count and therefore depends on the same broken rdps metric family; the evidence file lands no rows for this key, so all 27 stored ptrDummy records stay at 2026-08-10 (5 days, threshold 10) and the build's Dummy Dome composite is computed from unchanged data. The zone-52 RAW-DPS medians are a DIFFERENT statistic and did land (see wcl-dummy-raw) — raw DPS is never dressed up as rDPS.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-dummy-raw"] alone, which this agent can neither produce nor edit: 102 rows built and 102 applied by the deterministic pre-agent step, with all four DPS dummies ok — 1T 2000 ranked players, 2T 662, 3T 297, 5T 2000 (complete pagination per the frozen 2026-07-17 recipe, since rankings are best-parse-per-player sorted best-first and a partial median would be biased high). 103 of the 106 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Dummy Dome, NT)" rows now carry asOf 2026-08-15; the three that do not are 5T rows for specs with no parse in this cut, left untouched rather than re-dated. Coverage date 2026-08-15 (0 days, threshold 10). The fetch step merged these itself before this agent started — they were neither re-fetched, recomputed nor edited here.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"]: 27 rows built and 27 applied across the zone-54 Heroic boss pool, all eight encounters ok — Nek'zali the Soulcoiler 370 ranked players, Entombed Sentinels 363, Vashnik the Malignant 678, The Lost Explorers 150, Sszorak 184, The Twin Fangs 146, and The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek at 0, which is an empty encounter rather than an error. All 27 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Venomous Abyss, pooled)" rows carry asOf 2026-08-15. Written from the evidence file only; no WCL fetch of any kind was performed by this agent.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-mplus-raw"]: 27 rows built and 27 applied across all eight zone-56 dungeons, each returning the 2000-player pagination ceiling (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). All 27 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR M+ keys, pooled)" rows carry asOf 2026-08-15. Written from the evidence file only; this agent performed no WCL request.

All three meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 40-71 KB, parsed to 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs with 0 unmatched. The parser was corrected mid-run and the correction is worth recording: murlok writes the anchor attributes in either order (href before class on some rows, after on others), so an href-anchored split found only 10 of 40 rows while every page still returned HTTP 200 — the silent-shortfall shape that only a printed row count catches. Anchoring on the meta-item class and reading the href out of the tag gives 40/40. Every "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" value reproduces the stored number exactly (e.g. Guardian Druid 4268, Brewmaster Monk 4038, Blood DK 3990), so nothing needed merging and the stored dates stay at today's date from earlier runs of this UTC day. Honest caveat: each page's own <time datetime> reads 2026-08-12T02:17Z despite the site's "updated every 8 hours" claim, and the pages still label themselves Midnight Season 1 — upstream looks frozen even though our fetch is healthy.

All 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each (the 76-byte {"status":"error"} body is transient, not structural). FOURTEEN charts returned data and 13 still answer "No standard chart with these values found" after 3 tries — Augmentation Evoker is the known by-design absence, the other 12 (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Assassination, Outlaw, Demonology, Arms, Fury) are simply not re-simmed yet. Every one of the 14 carries simc_settings.tier MID2 against MID1 in stored data, and all 14 chart timestamps now read 2026-08-15, so upstream IS actively re-simming for Season 2 — just not the whole roster. Per the tier-uniformity gate the merge is HELD BACK WHOLESALE: MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so merging the 14 would publish "which specs bloodmallet has re-simmed" as spec strength. Stored fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHART's own 2026-07-08 (38 days, threshold 5) and the heartbeat stays red — that red is the true signal that upstream has not finished. Note for the night the roster completes: a wholesale adoption will also need a human value_move_ack, since 64 of 156 sim rows move more than 60%.

Both transports checked. MID1_Raid.txt is again a live in-progress log (272 bytes, no "DPS Ranking:" block) whose header reads "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69299 Live (hotfix 2026-08-15/69299, git build HEAD b642585cbf)" — a Season-2 re-sim is running right now. MID1_Raid.html therefore remains the only parseable report and it has NOT advanced: SimulationCraft 1205-01 for WoW 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974), git build 678e66d384, report timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000 — identical provenance to the stored cut, so an unchanged parse is the honest explanation rather than a fresh sim dressed up. Era-verified off that header string, not the visible "12.3.0" (which is the Highcharts version). Nothing merged; stored date stays 2026-08-08 (7 days, threshold 10). Expect a large one-off move when the 12.1 report publishes.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), HTTP 200, 184 KB, 302-resolving to period 1075 MID1 — the SAME period as the previous run, so no weekly roll and no half-landed roll. The parse was bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and stopped at the next heading, which is what keeps the "Classes and specs" block and the per-dungeon sections from inflating the row count to 59; labels were read from the lowercase-hyphenated alt attribute ("devourer demon-hunter") and normalised on both sides, and the value taken from the trailing span rather than the bar's height style. 34 specs returned, summing to 100.3% with role subtotals 60.2 DPS / 20.1 healer / 20.0 tank — the representation SHARE column, not the /meta per-key-presence figure. All 34 values are identical to stored; the 6 specs absent upstream are the 6 stored as explicit 0 and were left untouched. Nothing merged, so the coverage date stays 2026-08-14 (1 day, threshold 5).

Four channels swept, nothing new to log. (1) Official dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09Z, newest is Linxy #19 — already the feed's 07-31 entry. The thread has been quiet for 15 days because the PTR cycle ended when 12.1 shipped on 08-11. (2) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block: 40 items, newest 2026-08-15 15:35 CDT; every class-relevant item is already accounted for — "Season 2 Class Tuning Incoming with Weekly Reset" (news 382466) IS the feed's newest entry, logged earlier today from Linxy's standalone topic 2336820. (3) Wowhead news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) polled as well since it leads RSS within a run: 20 posts, top id 382472, nothing beyond RSS. (4) Blue-tracker payload (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries deduped to 42 topics; the only blues since the last logged build remain the Aug-14 Kaivax hotfixes (topic 2336376) and the Aug-12 "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans" roadmap (topic 2335871). Both were re-read in full tonight and independently confirmed as non-feed material: the hotfix Classes section is entirely BUG FIXES with no tuning values (Devastation Shattering Star/Mastery, Warrior Slayer Executioner double-effect, Warlock pet Soul Leech, Demonology cooldown manager) while its numeric changes are trinkets and items, and the roadmap is a schedule of future dates (Aug 18/25, Sep 1/22) with no per-spec lines. Writing either as "Spec Class - ..." highlights would put bug-fix and calendar text into the outlook tally. One LEAD recorded but not logged: "Patch 12.1.5 PTR Now Listed on Battle.net Launcher" (news 382443, 08-13) — a new cycle means a NEW forum thread, but the article states the patch has not been updated and no datamining is possible yet, so there is nothing to re-discover. WCL zones 54/52/56/57 were NOT fetched by this agent (no credentials); their state is recorded from wcl-fetch/evidence.json in the five wcl-* rows above. Writeup coverage recomputed rather than read from prose: exactly one spec has no ptr writeup (Demonology Warlock, the deliberate "the source reported no changes" case) and zero specs lack a raid-scoped or an M+-scoped expert read.

Discovery ran clean; distillation was impossible. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "limit-exceeded" (requested 1, fetched 0, bqVHzvKJCuA) — the Supadata free-tier monthly budget is exhausted, so no transcript existed to distil and no take or metaNote was added. This agent fetched no transcript from YouTube or any transcript API. RSS discovery: all 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff, 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries scanned against a 1035-id seen-set built from the four structured lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] plus every youtu.be id in creator-takes.json), never by regex over log prose. 17 videos were unseen. ONE was retired to seen[] as a durable dismissal on an explicit PvP frame, permanently out of scope for this PvE tracker: 80dIIds3qPM (Dalaran Gaming, "What Did Blizzard Do To ROGUES In 12.1? (5v5 1v1 Duels) - PvP"), the same shape as oUjUd8kcWew retired earlier today. NONE was queued: the queue already holds 12 videos against an exhausted monthly budget, and every other unseen video tonight is guide/route-shaped (Tactyks' S2 routes, Sha's Temple of Sethraliss route, Megasett's Mistweaver M+ guide, Baze's Fury guide, Dalaran's Assassination guide), stream- or Short-shaped (Tettles x2, Critcake, Kalamazi, NeekapHere, a Megasett achievement Short, Maximum's live AWTF test stream), raw footage (Harrek's Dummy Dome healer pulls) or a Supatease upload whose channel reads PvP by default — none of which is a durable judgment, so all 16 were left UNSEEN and stay reconsiderable by a local run rather than being marked off. The one genuine borderline is mzjGn70Hf20 (AutomaticJak, "Updating Tier Lists then M0s!"): it is stream-shaped and the same creator's dedicated tier-list video from the same day (c_5u7Jpy-Uo) is already queued, so it was left unseen rather than spending a second request on likely-duplicate content. yt-dlp was tried ONCE to settle that video's duration and live status and hit the expected datacenter bot wall ("Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"); it was not retried, and bqVHzvKJCuA therefore remains queued and remains the suspected still-live stream first flagged on 08-09 — left in place rather than purged on a guess. No creator `latest` field was advanced, since nothing was distilled.
